question: What biodiesel yield did Harb et al. obtain from spent coffee ground oil, and at what methanol-to-oil ratio and temperature?
rendered: According to the document, Harb et al. prepared a kinetic model in Aspen Plus to generate biodiesel from spent coffee ground oil and achieved a biodiesel yield of 90.31% with a methanol to oil ratio of 12 : 1 and reaction temperature of 60 °C.
